title: Before an archive-then-delete, the archive holds origin's tip, not only the local tip
why: Lane agent-report-shas-resolve (session_013NEJL1333yS5ziKFeWsjHC), 13:22 CST Nov 8, its own mistake: it amended local send-message-refs-resolve to 660db61b0, then archived it, so archive/send-message-refs-resolve got 660db61b0, not origin's 576ec5b5c (closed #1864's head). The remote delete did nothing, so 576ec5b5c is still kept on that branch. Harm: an archive that does not hold the commit it should keep. Fix: the archive step checks that local tip equals origin's tip, or archives origin's tip too, before any delete.
